messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

message.content:
I’m afraid I don’t have a built‑in way to pull up a calendar of Canadian public holidays for 2023 on demand. However, you can easily obtain that information from a few reliable sources:

| Source | How to access |
|--------|---------------|
| **Government of Canada – Public Holidays** | Visit the official federal website (https://www.canada.ca/en/services/benefits/public-holidays.html) which lists all statutory holidays by province and territory. |
| **TimeandDate.com** | Go to https://www.timeanddate.com/calendar/canada-2023.html – it shows a full calendar with all holidays highlighted. |
| **Calendar APIs** | Services such as Calendarific (https://calendarific.com/) or HolidayAPI (https://holidayapi.com/) let you query holidays programmatically via REST endpoints. You’ll need an API key, but they support Canada and allow filtering by year. |

If you’d like, I can walk you through setting up a simple script that calls one of those APIs and returns the dates in JSON format so you can import them into your holiday‑planning app. Just let me know which approach you prefer!
